definitions.full: H4113. mahamorah [ מַהֲמֹרָה ] noun feminine flood (compare Arabic √), or watery pit (properly place of flowing waters ; compare Symm βοθύνους , and Late Hebrew, NHWB iii. 40 ) — only plural מַהֲמֹרוֺת Psa 140:11 (Gr Che מכמרות , nets , see below כמר ; compare רֶשֶׁת 140:6 ).
